rows.speaker: doctor
rows.heard: I want to ask you, about your sleep.
rows.said: 我想问你，关于你的睡眠。

rows.speaker: doctor
rows.heard: Take 500 milligrams three times a day for seven days.
rows.said: 服用500 毫克一天三次，连服七天。

rows.speaker: doctor
rows.heard: Tell me about the pain, when it started, what makes it worse, whether it spreads anywhere else, and how it affects your sleep at night.
rows.said: 告诉我关于疼痛的情况，什么时候开始的，什么让它变严重，是否扩散到其他地方，以及它如何影响你晚上的睡眠。

rows.speaker: patient
rows.said: I'm afraid this medicine will make me drowsy.
